fixes.fix: Look like the GitHub Copilot mascot, not the Claude logo. Reference: a rounded dome helmet shading purple at the top to blue at the bottom; big pilot goggles pushed up on the forehead, two rounded-square lenses with lighter purple rims joined by a bridge; a dark navy rounded-rectangle face visor with a lighter blue rim; two tall cyan (#12f0f5) pill-shaped eyes; round blue ear cups on both sides of the head.
Give the character two legs only.

Look like the Codex icon. Reference: a scalloped cloud or flower blob with about 8 rounded bumps, a vertical gradient from lavender (#b0a8ff) at the top to strong blue (#3d4bff) at the bottom, and a white terminal prompt '>_' (a rounded chevron and a rounded underscore) on its face.
Draw two characters side by side: a full-size avatar shaped like the letter P, and a tiny companion next to it shaped like the letter i, so together they read 'Pi'.

Look more like the Google Antigravity 'A'. Reference: a smooth arch or bell shape with no crossbar, a rounded peak, the inner opening a soft rounded arch, and the two legs flaring outward into rounded feet that curl out at the bottom. Gradient: green at the top left, red at the top right, both blending into bright blue (#3388ff) over the lower body.
